contributor to MP (1898) and other periodicals as \'Henley I.

Arden\'

Henrietta Knight was editor, under this pseudonym, of Friendly Leaves, 1890-1899.

She became editor of another GFS periodical, the Girls\' Quarterly, in 1900.

Henley in Arden is a town in Warwickshire. [COPAC]
